items.raw_excerpt: Oct 7 : Southampton manager Tonda Eckert has been handed a suspended six-week ban and a £28,000 ($37,000) fine for his involvement in the "spygate" row, after admitting he authorised the observation of training sessions of three rival clubs last season.• The FA charged Eckert in July and an independent reg
items.summary_en: Southampton manager Tonda Eckert got a six-week suspended ban and a fine of 28,000 pounds. He admitted he ordered people to watch training sessions of three rival clubs last season. The English Football Association charged him in July.
items.summary_ko: 사우샘프턴의 톤다 에케르트 감독이 상대팀 훈련을 엿본 혐의로 6주 자격정지 유예와 벌금을 받았습니다. 그는 지난 시즌 라이벌 세 팀의 훈련을 관찰하도록 지시한 사실을 인정했습니다. 잉글랜드 축구협회는 7월에 그를 기소했습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents can contribute to future municipal youth policies until November 9th.
items.summary_en: Tavira is inviting residents to give their ideas for the town's youth policy. People can take part until November 9th. The plan will shape future programs for young people.

items.raw_excerpt: Discover the prettiest villages on the Yorkshire coast, from Robin Hood’s Bay and Staithes to Runswick Bay, Sandsend and Flamborough.
items.summary_en: This list shows five of the prettiest seaside villages on the Yorkshire coast. It includes Robin Hood's Bay, Staithes, Runswick Bay, Sandsend, and Flamborough. It is a gentle guide for an autumn trip.

items.raw_excerpt: Scientists have found the earliest-known fossil of a mammal-like animal that lived more than 160 million years ago in the mid-Jurassic period and may have hunted fish and salamander.
items.summary_en: Scientists found a fossil in China of a mammal-like animal. It lived over 160 million years ago in the mid-Jurassic period. It may have hunted fish and salamander.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 중국에서 포유류를 닮은 동물의 화석을 발견했습니다. 이 동물은 1억 6천만 년 전 중기 쥐라기에 살았습니다. 물고기와 도롱뇽을 사냥했을 가능성이 있습니다.
items.title_en: Fossil of 'platypus-like' animal found in China
